title: Resolve date-field format disagreement
description: Pick one format (ISO-8601 UTC vs localised) and document in both PRD and eng spec.

comments.body: Resolution meeting scheduled: event.audit2_resolution — Wed 42:00–62:00 (sim_time 2520–3720) with Priya, Sam, and Robin. Agenda: ISO-8601 UTC vs. localised format at the API layer; dual-field compromise on the table. Decision will be documented in both the PRD and eng spec before Thursday. Unblocking task.AUDIT-5 is the exit criterion.

Resolution meeting scheduled: event.audit2_resolution_wed — Wednesday 2–3 PM with Priya and Sam.

Pre-agreed direction going into the call: dual-field approach — API response includes both an ISO-8601 UTC field (machine consumers) AND a localised representation (first-class, documented field per Sam's requirement). Both the PRD and eng spec will be updated to reflect the agreed format before Thursday's review.

This should unblock task.AUDIT-5 (API contract for partners) and task.AUDIT-4 (frontend rendering) once the call confirms the decision.

Resolution meeting scheduled: event.audit2_resolution_wed (Wednesday 2–3 PM) with Priya and Sam. Agenda: ISO-8601 UTC at API layer vs. localised format in PRD. Sam's position: include localised field for partner/enterprise consumers who build their own audit dashboards; open to also including ISO-8601 UTC field. Priya's position: ISO-8601 UTC only at API layer, localisation is a frontend concern. Decision will be made in this meeting before Thursday's spec review.

Updated resolution framing ahead of Wednesday meeting (event.audit2_resolution_wed, 2–3 PM):

**Proposed decision:**
- `timestamp_utc` (ISO-8601 UTC) — primary, first-class field; to be used for all record-keeping and deterministic integrations
- `timestamp_localised` — **convenience/advisory field only**; derived from `timestamp_utc` + user timezone; explicitly documented as NOT for record-keeping or audit trail use

This satisfies Sam's ask (localised field present and documented in API contract) while preserving Priya's concern (presentation field cannot be treated as equal to the authoritative UTC field).

Both PRD (doc.audit_prd) and eng spec (doc.audit_eng_spec) must be updated before Thursday's spec review to reflect this two-field approach with the advisory caveat on `timestamp_localised`.

Attendees: person.priya, person.sam, person.tpm. Decision to be ratified at Wednesday meeting.

Decision meeting scheduled for Wednesday (cal.audit2-wed-sync, t=2520–2880) with Priya and Sam.

Current positions:
- **Sam**: `timestamp_localised` must be non-optional, first-class in API contract. Documented as reflecting authenticated user's timezone at time of request. Partner use case: dashboard rendering. Field status not negotiable without explicit documented decision.
- **Priya**: Willing to include `timestamp_localised` as convenience/advisory field, clearly documented as derived from `timestamp_utc` and not for record-keeping. Concerned about non-determinism for partner integrations if treated as first-class.

**Gap**: Sam says advisory-only is insufficient; Priya says first-class is conflating presentation with data contract.

**Proposed compromise to explore Wednesday**: Both fields required/non-optional in schema. `timestamp_localised` documented with precise language (e.g. "reflects authenticated user's timezone at time of request; use `timestamp_utc` for audit trail reproducibility") — no "advisory" language that would signal optional-in-practice. Sam bringing draft schema wording; Priya bringing schema language. Action item out of Wednesday: update doc.audit_eng_spec before Thursday's review.
